queries.result: The official Bosaso Municipality portal was found, but its public site is an information/services portal. No Bosaso-specific cadastral viewer, parcel API, public service configuration, or safe parcel geometry/identity endpoint was verified. An authoritative land-governance report provides historical evidence that Bosaso had local registration and land-department functions, but it is not current machine-readable source integration evidence.
